authority_id.description: Corporation DID (the authority doing the recognizing).

action.description: Preserved on the wire for TRQP conformance; the v4 answer is action-invariant.

context.description: Optional TRQP context. `session_id` (Verana profile extension) takes precedence over `time`.

session_id.description: Binds the answer to a Verana participant session; denied with `session not found` when it does not exist or does not match the authority's corporation.
